import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter data for the top 10 breeds by number of registrations
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of the top breeds by district
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, x='Rasse1Text', hue='KreisLang', order=top_breeds, palette='Set2')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds by District in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.legend(title='District', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')
